ios.desc:
Take control of your finances and achieve your financial goals with Amounts, the powerful personal expense tracker and budgeting app designed to simplify your financial life. Whether you want to track your daily expenses, create a budget, or collect your business purchases, Amounts is here to help you manage money every step of the way. Say goodbye to financial stress and hello to financial freedom!

Effortless Expense Tracking   
With Amounts, simply log your expenses on the go, effortlessly categorize them, and gain instant insights into your spending habits. Our intuitive interface allows you to record cash or credit card transactions with just a few taps, so you can focus on what matters most - managing your wallet.

Insightful Budgeting Tools  
Create budgets tailored to your needs and gain control over your spending. Amounts empowers you to set realistic spending limits for different categories, helping you stay on track and avoid overspending. Know where every dollar of your budget goes and climb your way out of debt!

Smart Charts  
Uncover the secrets behind your spending patterns with our smart financial charts. See daily, weekly, monthly and yearly breakdowns of your spending. Compare different time periods with just a few taps. Identify areas where you can cut back and make informed financial decisions that align with your goals and help you build wealth.

Secure and Private  
We understand that your financial information is sensitive, which is why we prioritize the highest level of security. All of your Amounts data lives either directly on your device, or in your personal iCloud account if you enable cloud sync.

Seamless Sync Across Devices  
Your financial life doesn't stop at your iPhone; it extends to your iPad and Mac. Amounts seamlessly syncs your data across all your devices safely and securly via iCloud, so you can access your financial information anytime, anywhere. Start adding an expense on your iPhone, and finish editing it on your iPad without missing a beat.

Intuitive and Personalized Experience  
We've designed Amounts with your convenience in mind. Our app boasts a clean and intuitive interface, making it easy for you to navigate and manage your finances efficiently. Personalize your experience by choosing from a range of beautiful color palettes to suit your style. Each category you create can be customized with over 100 searchable icons. Amounts is here to make your financial journey enjoyable!

quotes.text:
Amounts 3 is a complete rewrite of my nearly 10 year old expense tracking iOS app, Amounts. Amounts is a manual personal expense tracker designed to be local first and private - none of your personal data goes to any server other than your own iCloud account, if you enable cloud sync.

The app is completely free to use, but does feature a subscription for more dedicated users (More customization options, better export options.)

I built Amounts as a supplement to other apps like Mint. For me personally, I hate using cash, but also missed the "feeling" of spending money. When using cash you physically see the money going away and becoming less. Swiping a credit card is just too easy, so the idea is to introduce a slight bit of friction by manually inputing transactions right after purchase to make sure you are aware of how much you are spending. It is not an easy habit to get into, and not everyone needs it, but it can pay off if it works for you.

Any feedback is greatly appreciated.
